incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Threshold breach: 5xx rate 11.8% over 5m window. Incident ID INC-20260312-208765. Paging on-call (alex_w). Please ack and triage.

alex_w: Acked. Looking at dashboards now. Any recent deploys?

charlie_k: No deploys from infra in the last hour. Saw a few model-runner restarts in the logs starting ~5m ago.

alex_w: OK. Pulling logs from model-runner in us-west-2.

infra-bot: Snapshot logs (tail last 200 lines) from model-runner-rt-7b-3 pods in us-west-2:

```
[ERR] 2026-03-12T21:33:40Z model-runner[pid=4213]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c12a34 sp 0x7f...
[INFO] 2026-03-12T21:33:41Z kubelet: container crashed, restartCount=1
[ERR] 2026-03-12T21:33:44Z model-runner[pid=4321]: OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 512MB
[WARN] 2026-03-12T21:33:45Z runtime: KV cache dropped for session xyz
```

charlie_k: That looks like a memory pressure -> segfault cascade. I'm seeing consistent SIGSEGV in the llm-attention kernel. p95 latency jumps and 5xx are originating from the model-runner process crashing mid-request.

maria_s: Customer impact check: CS reported two enterprise customers (acme-inc + betahealth) seeing errors and timeouts in the past 10 minutes. No SSO/customer PII exposed. We should set severity to P1 until we have a mitigation.

alex_w: Agree P1. Immediate mitigation options: 1) Shift traffic from the crashing 7b variant to a compatible 7b-quantized variant or a 3b fallback. 2) Temporarily disable batching and reduce max_tokens to lower memory use. 3) Restart pods on a rolling basis after changing env to reduce chunking. Which do we want first?

charlie_k: I can flip routing to 7b-quant-8bit variant (compatible API). It's lower perf but should avoid the kernel path causing segfaults. Do we have capacity in other regions?

sre_lead: We have spare capacity in us-east-1. But cross-region reroute will add latency and may affect SLAs. Prefer local fallback variant first.

alex_w: OK charlie, go ahead with route change. maria, draft customer comms for impacted customers with mitigation + ETA.

charlie_k: Doing the route change now. Command I used: 

```
# route traffic from model:rt-7b to model:rt-7b-quant-8
redwoodctl routes update --from model:rt-7b --to model:rt-7b-quant-8 --region us-west-2 --weight 100 --dry-run=false
```

charlie_k: Route update succeeded. New traffic split: rt-7b -> 0%, rt-7b-quant-8 -> 100% in us-west-2.

infra-bot: Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 11.8% -> 2.4% within 90s of route change. Pod crash rate reduced.

alex_w: Nice. Next: disable batching to prevent large prefix allocations. Deploy config change to runtime pool: set BATCH_WINDOW_MS=0 and MAX_BATCH_SIZE=1 for the model-runner pool.

charlie_k: Pushing config via k8s configmap patch and rolling restart command below:

```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap model-runner-config -p '{"data":{"BATCH_WINDOW_MS":"0","MAX_BATCH_SIZE":"1"}}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-runner-rt-7b
```

charlie_k: Config applied and rolling restart underway. Restart completed on 6/6 pods. Verified healthchecks passing.

maria_s: Customer comms draft: "Hi <customer>, we saw elevated 5xx errors starting at 21:33 UTC impacting the /v1/generate endpoint for some requests. We have shifted traffic to a compatible model variant and disabled batching. Errors are decreasing; we expect full recovery within 15 minutes. No data loss suspected. We'll follow up with a timeline and RCA." Thoughts?

customer-success-bot: Message queued to acme-inc and betahealth. Internal ticket created CS-5972.

alex_w: Monitoring: p95 latency back to baseline, 5xx rate stable ~0.5% over 5m. Keeping this incident open for RCA and kernel analysis.

charlie_k: Collecting core dumps and kernel logs for the segfaults, and grabbing the exact model checkpoint and kernel binary versions. Suspect a recent BLAS/kernels update on that node image interacting poorly with quantization code path.

infra-bot: Core dumps archived to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-20260312-208765/ and debug bundle uploaded to the incident runbook.

maria_s: Handoff plan: I'll own incident comms and RCA. alex_w please hand off to night on-call after one more monitoring check at +30m. If anything regresses, escalate to eng runtime.

alex_w: Handing off to night on-call (charlie_k will take first line during night). Leaving processors scaled down and routing pinned to quant variant until patch. Leaving notes in the runbook.

sre_lead: Thanks team. Post-incident actions: 1) Reproduce segfault in staging with the same kernel+model build. 2) Revert kernel/lib changes or pin to previous working image. 3) Add synthetic load test to catch this class of OOM->segfault. 4) Add automatic fallback routing on repeated crashes (circuit breaker).

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260312-208765 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Time to mitigate: ~4 minutes to restore acceptable error rate. Assigned owners: maria_s (comms/RCA), charlie_k (runtime investigation), alex_w (on-call postmortem).

alex_w: Acknowledged. Closing triage for now, will update postmortem with timeline and kernel analysis. :white_check_mark:"
